skills.name: Shield of Light
skills.text: Reduce the damage of a power move by 1.

skills.name: Mint Leaf
skills.text: Use this on a monster afflicted with "cannot attack" to remove the status.

skills.name: Fusion
skills.text: Ko two of your monsters. Replace them with a mixed-breed monster, combining the main-breed of one and the sub-breed of the other. It cannot attack this turn.

skills.name: Fair and Square
skills.text: Breeder cards other than environment cards cannot be played.

skills.name: Ironclad Defense
skills.text: Block cards can be used without spending guts.

skills.name: Melee
skills.text: All monsters can attack any number of times during the same turn.

skills.name: Blooming Talents
skills.text: Special moves can be used without spending guts.

skills.name: Blizzard
skills.text: This damages all opponent's monsters. Monsters damaged by this move cannot attack next turn.

skills.name: Evil Final
skills.text: This cannot be dodged. Damage increases by the amount of gali skill cards in your discard pile.

skills.name: Charge
skills.text: If this is not dodged, this monster also takes 2 damage.

skills.name: Front Roll
skills.text: Dodge a power or an intelligence move with 1 or more guts cost (before modifications).

skills.name: Big Bang
skills.text: This cannot be dodged. Damage increases by the amount of this monster's missing life points.

skills.name: Total Exertion
skills.text: Use with a power move. Its damage cannot be reduced by block moves.

skills.name: Instant Kill
skills.text: Use with a power move. It cannot be blocked or dodged.

skills.name: Deep Shriek
skills.text: Both players discard all cards from their hand.

skills.name: Nyah Nyah
skills.text: During the next turn, your opponent can only use damaging moves if they would affect this monster (before resolving defense).

skills.name: Shadow Bind
skills.text: Play with a monster's power or an intelligence move, and then name a block or dodge move. Your opponent cannot defend with the named move.
